reference: SCOPE-0 (what has been measured of two language models, by site)
changes: version 3 (2026-11-12): Gemma's frame is closed with per-layer scales by CAL-G; the hand-over's plain-sum attributions stay void. Version 2 (2026-11-12), on the corrections of the session that owns the instrument: the part-of-speech probe was paired with a null of a different quantity (novel-word accuracy against an all-word null) and is now accuracy on all words against that null, with a second view for what is readable beyond the surface bytes; VOCAB-1 was called exploratory and is preregistered and UNCONVERGED, carried as a separate field; the push views read the log-probability of the adjective word, not log-odds; the parallax scale cut off its own null band; PARALLAX-2 added. No loop result is imported: every one so far ran on a superseded engine.
serves: a model explorer: one exact kind of reading per map; a cell with no row is drawn as not measured

verdict.reason: copied readings of other sessions' experiments; nothing here was re-derived or scored by this repository

law: a cell is a reading in a regime: its model, file, prompt, position and kind are part of the value. No cell is carried to a neighbouring site, to another model, or to another kind of reading.

standings.preregistered: measured under a preregistration, with an interval or a null beside it
standings.exploratory: formed by looking: descriptive or found while exploring; a lead, not a finding
standings.void: a number exists but its instrument does not hold here (the frame does not close, or the stake's plant failed); drawn as void, never as a value

holds_no_real_feature: no person or place; sites are layers and blocks of two public model files, values are aggregate statistics over prompts
limits: two models, one checkpoint and one quantisation each
GoldWorm rows are English children's stories at byte level; Gemma rows are 124 curated items
intervals are 95 % intervals as stored; no file stores a standard error
the hand-over bundle is not under version control; its files are pinned by digest alone
which experiments a layer draws on was chosen by the CIRISHolon session and corrected once by the RATCHET session, which owns the instrument (2026-11-12)
not yet in the table: the loop's stakes (none live), MLP0-4, EDIT-2's withdrawal, and the gate's prices from PARALLAX-H
